title: 6-DOF UR arm with gripper
subtitle: UR5e + Robotiq 2F-85
summary: Menagerie's UR5e with Menagerie's Robotiq 2F-85 on its flange, composed the way bam_arm.cell composes them (attach at attachment_site, prefix grip_). Beyond the arm's joint zeros and joint friction, calibration finds the tool the arm carries (the gripper's mass and centre of mass, the TCP at the pads) and the gripper's drive (the force per command count and the closing damping, which set its width map).

sensors.measures: joint angle (the encoder, offset from the link by the joint zero) and speed
motor torque from current (what the UR controller reports)
the flange pose from a tag on the flange, seen by a calibrated external camera
the finger drive's angle (the 2F-85 reports its position)
a marker held between the pads, seen by the same external camera

known.note: the arm's position servos as in the UR5e example; the gripper's position spring (biasprm[1] = -100) and its force limit (5 N) as Menagerie states them

tree.title: the tool the arm carries (gripper + coupling) and its TCP

schedule.excitation: Fourier series per joint (Swevers 1997): 5 harmonics of 0.2 Hz, 10 s, inside the joint and speed limits

coverage.function: type_cards.coverage.arm_coverage (4 cells per joint inside the limits: the 4096-cell joint cube)
coverage.rule: share of the joint cube's cells the static poses and the excitations (every 50 ms) visit; tool voxels need FK (a marginal, not planned here)

notes: The tracker sees the flange through a calibrated external camera: its frame is the arm's base frame (hand-eye is the dual-arm cell's job).
Contacts are off: no example here calibrates contact (the gripper card's grip force and contact friction stay unidentified).
The 2F-85's grip force map and contact friction (arm_6dof_gripper's parameters) need a force gauge and pull-out tests; not simulated.
